mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, ROLE, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{zipcode}, #{address1}, #{address2}, 'USER', 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT login_id FROM MEMBER WHERE name = #{name} AND email = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET password = #{password}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, zipcode = #{zipcode}, address1 = #{address1}, address2 = #{address2}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{member_id}
mapper.select: SELECT IATA_CODE, AIRPORT_NAME FROM AIRPORT WHERE is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY IATA_CODE ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET STATUS = 'DELETED', UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{member_id}
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, LOGIN_ID, NAME, EMAIL, STATUS FROM MEMBER WHERE EMAIL = #{email}
SELECT region_id AS REGION_ID, region_name AS REGION_NAME FROM REGION WHERE is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY region_id ASC

SELECT A.airport_id AS AIRPORT_ID, A.iata_code AS IATA_CODE, A.airport_name AS AIRPORT_NAME, A.region_id AS REGION_ID, R.region_name AS REGION_NAME FROM AIRPORT A INNER JOIN REGION R ON A.region_id = R.region_id WHERE A.is_active = 'Y' ORDER BY A.airport_name ASC

SELECT MEMBER_ID, NAME, TO_CHAR(BIRTH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_DATE, PHONE, GENDER, PASSPORT_NO, TO_CHAR(PASSPORT_EXPIRY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PASSPORT_EXPIRY FROM SAVED_PASSENGER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO SAVED_PASSENGER S USING DUAL ON (S.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET S.NAME = #{name}, S.BIRTH_DATE = TO_DATE(#{birthDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), S.GENDER = #{gender}, S.PHONE = #{phone}, S.PASSPORT_NO = #{passportNo}, S.PASSPORT_EXPIRY = TO_DATE(#{passportExpiry}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_ID, NAME, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER, PHONE, PASSPORT_NO, PASSPORT_EXPIRY) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{name}, TO_DATE(#{birthDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{gender}, #{phone}, #{passportNo}, TO_DATE(#{passportExpiry}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
